$comment: Machine-readable index. An agent reads this first and uses read_order to decide which documents to load. Keep it honest and current: a stale manifest is worse than an empty one.

current_risk.summary: <nothing established yet — this knowledge base was just created>

read_order.why: established facts, to avoid re-deriving them
changes already made — read before mutating anything

structure.rule: First-hand records go into your own directory. A conclusion every agent should know goes into the shared layer.

test_path_rules.$comment: Fill this in when you learn it. Before ordering any escalation test, record: is the path already writable, and can the helper change its ACL. A failed grant can break the whole turn.
preconditions_for_an_escalation_test: the path must NOT already be writable by the agent (otherwise the test proves nothing)
the path must be owned by the user (otherwise the helper cannot rewrite its ACL)
a failure can break the current turn — do not run the test in an important session

append_protocol.required_tagging: Distinguish 【已验证】/【推断】/【假设】 in the body; never write the last two as the first.
append_protocol.sync_obligation: When you establish something every agent should know, update the shared layer (01 facts / 03 mods / 04 playbook / 05 mistakes / 07 paths / this manifest).
append_protocol.public_export: Nothing in this knowledge base is published. Anything that does leave the machine passes references/privacy.md first.
